prompt:
Produce up to 4 distinct, useful design or engineering actions for the task below. Explore materially different mechanisms, including non-obvious alternatives. Respect every constraint. Give executable changes in the target domain, with an implementation step and a falsifiable check. Do not claim unmeasured gains, invent supporting facts, or rename the same action several ways. State actions in the user's terms; omit donor names and analogy explanations from the answer. Fewer actions, including none, are acceptable when no additional valid action remains. Keep each action compact: aim for 60–80 words TOTAL across its five fields, never more than 110. Suggested field budgets: action 8 words, mechanism 16, implementation 22, check 20, risk 10. The 110-word maximum applies to the SUM of all five values, not to each field.

Task:
{
  "title": "Conflicting edits in several tabs",
  "brief": "A web form editor is often open in two tabs. A save in one tab can overwrite newer work in the other, while the current warning modal gives no clue which fields differ. Fields include long text and single-choice values.",
  "constraints": [
    "Server exposes a document revision number and rejects a stale save.",
    "Never silently discard text from either tab.",
    "Users must be able to finish without dragging or copying between windows.",
    "Do not auto-publish the merged draft."
  ],
  "success_criteria": [
    "A user can identify and resolve only conflicting fields.",
    "Nonconflicting edits do not require retyping.",
    "A test covers a stale tab whose last edit happened after the other tab saved."
  ],
  "non_goals": [
    "Implementing real-time collaborative editing."
  ]
}
Optional outside cue:
Donor domain: Lighthouse sector signals
Relation: One source presents different signals depending on the observer's direction relative to it. An observer can distinguish an ordinary navigational indication from a specifically marked hazardous sector when the directional signal is interpreted together with the surrounding map. Location determines which warning is relevant.
Boundary: The observer needs a reliable way to identify the source and interpret the sector. A signal is not universal permission; degraded visibility, boundaries, and other hazards remain outside what that one signal establishes.
Treat the relation as an optional prompt for exploration. Transfer useful relationships, not surface nouns. The donor is not evidence that a target intervention will work. Ignore the cue if it cannot support a valid move.

Return JSON only: {"actions":[{"action":"...","mechanism":"...","implementation":"...","check":"...","risk":"..."}],"abstention_reason":""}. Use abstention_reason only to explain an empty action list. No tools or additional research.
